notes.title: Major update - Mastery of Time (Version 1.1)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33667321/6113c498cf63ab216136700389ba395fc3c3ae19.png

We are very happy to let you know that Firebase Defence has now been updated!
This major update, adds a time control feature, gameplay improvements and bug fixes.

 Mastery of Time (Time control feature)
It is now possible to the pause and unpause anytime doing the game.
This has been the number one requested feature in the feedback we have received from you, so we are very happy about this update!

We have also added a fast mode, that plays the game at 2 x speed. This lets you speed up the game, if there is a "slow" period. 

At anytime during the game, you can press 'Z' (Pause), 'X' (Normal) or 'C' (Fast), to change the gamespeed. You can also press 'Space' for quick pause and unpause.

 Changelog

New stuff:

    Time control feature
    Game pauses when you open the menu (Or press 'Esc')


Fixed/Changes:

    Bullet hitboxes were changed to work at 2 x speed
    Upgrade, dismiss and sell hotkeys changed, to make room the for time control hotkeys
    Fixed a bug with the Gunners muzzle position
    Fixed a bug with the turret aim and muzzle position
    A lot of small fixes and changes



Please let us know if you have any issues with this update - We appreciate your support!

notes.title: Firebase Defence has been updated! (Version 1.0.5)
notes.content:
We are happy to let you know that Firebase Defence has now been updated.


Changelog:

New stuff:

 Hotkeys - All defences, units and ammunitions can now be build with hotkeys. Also deployables, unit upgrades/dismiss and remove defences can be controlled using hotkeys.

 Easy mode - It is now possible to enable Easy mode in the mission select screen. 
Easy mode has the following effect on gameplay:
- Enemies has reduced health
- Enemies weapon damage is reduced
- Turrets and off map support recharges faster
- Increased starting blood and material


Fixed/Changes:

 Screenshots using the built in screenshot feature in Steam now works
 Fixed a bug where players would get stuck on the Mission Accomplished screen
 A lot of small bugs and adjustments


Please let us know if you have any issues with this update - We appreciate your support

notes.title: Hotfix - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hotfix - Soldiers not hitting attack-dogs
We have pushed a hotfix to Steam, that should fix the issue some users have with soldiers not hitting attack-dogs properly.

If you still experience issues with this, please let us know.


Other fixes and new stuff
We really appreciate your feedback, and here is some of the things we are currently working on:

 Hotkeys - Every function will get a hotkey, so you can build your defences and units even faster!
 Volume sliders
 Game pause - If the user opens the menu, or taps out of the game
 Reported bugs and issues


This is far from everything - More will follow! :)
